feeds.title: GAHF Blog
feeds.description: All news updates, announcements, special programs, and other information regarding GAHF's work. Read in the latest posts. The German-American Heritage Foundation of the USA celebrates German-Americans and Americans of German-speaking ancestry culture, heritage, and immigration in the nation's capital.

feeds.title: German American Internee Coalition Blog
feeds.description: GAIC is a non-profit in America dedicated to making public the little-known United States World War II policies that led to the internment, repatriation, and exchange of civilians of German ethnicity. Our blog reports updates, information and commemorative articles on German history and other news.

feeds.title: The Oma Way
feeds.description: The Oma Way features authentic German recipes for homemade meals. You will find recipes as well as information and tips on how to manage German living in America. Oma is a German Grandmother living in the USA who loves to share her homemaking skills and experiences including the preparation of balanced, healthy food from German Recipes.

feeds.title: America's German Roots Blog
feeds.description: America's German Roots Blog is a portal to discover interesting German-American Culture ties. Find awesome places, clubs, heritage sites, museums, and German-American businesses. Germanrootsusa.org is an online directory collectively inform about German-American places, people and organizations to a larger audience.

feeds.title: A German Girl in America Blog
feeds.description: Keep up with articles from A German Girl in America. Each week we bring you our latest posts offering Gernaman cultural insights, Special giveaways, and more. A German Girl in America is a Culture blog by Karen Anne where she shares German Culture, Recipes, Literature, and humor with readers.
